And for many Martyrs.}}And vvhen you {{ls}}hal heare of vvarres and {{ls}}editions, be not terrified: the{{ls}}e things mu{{ls}}t fir{{ls}}t come to pa{{ls}}{{ls}}e, but the end is not yet by and by. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=10}} Then he {{ls}}aid to them, Nation {{ls}}hal ri{{ls}}e again{{ls}}t nation, and kingdom again{{ls}}t kingdom. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=11}} And there {{ls}}hal be great earth-quakes in places, and pe{{ls}}tilences and famines, and terrours from heauen, and there {{ls}}hal be great {{ls}}ignes. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=12}} But before al the{{ls}}e things they vvil {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Great per{{ls}}ecution of Catholike men.}}∷ lay their hands vpon you: and per{{ls}}ecute you deliuering you into {{ls}}ynagogs and pri{{ls}}ons, dravving you to kings and pre{{ls}}idents for my name. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=13}} and it {{ls}}hal happen vnto you for te{{ls}}timonie. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=14}} Lay vp this therfore in your hartes, not to premeditate hovv you {{ls}}hal an{{ls}}vver. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=15}} For I vvil giue you mouth and vvi{{ls}}edom, vvhich al your aduer{{ls}}aries {{ls}}hal not be able to re{{ls}}i{{ls}}t and gaine{{ls}}ay. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=16}} And you {{ls}}hal be deliuered vp of your parents and brethren, and kin{{ls}}emen & frendes: and they vvil put to death of you. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=17}} And you {{ls}}hal be odious to al men for my name: {{verse|chapter=21|verse=18}} and a heare of your head {{ls}}hal not peri{{ls}}h. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=19}} In your patience you {{ls}}hal po{{ls}}{{ls}}e{{ls}}{{ls}}e your {{ls}}oules.⊣
